name: Web Scrape Planner API
shortDescription: Deterministic crawl planner — batches, per-batch timing, total ETA, and a sample schedule from pages + throughput
description: Agent-native crawl planner computed in pure arithmetic — no fetch, no LLM. /plan takes total pages, throughput (robots Crawl-delay or requested RPS), batch size, concurrency, and a retry-overhead %, and returns effective RPS, batch count, last-batch size, per-batch timing, a total ETA (seconds + human-readable), and a sample batch schedule with cumulative pages and start offsets. The one-call /lookup adds reasoning (why_result_generated, key_factors, invalidators) and sequencing guidance. Deterministic, confidence 1.0.
